For the one who always controls the music.

Spin Master is a 500-piece puzzle that celebrates the art of the DJ. A DJ deep in the mix sits at the center, surrounded by swirling records and pulsing lights in bold color.

It's made for music lovers, party people and art fans. Put on a set, work through it one record at a time, and frame it when the last piece drops in.
